{"hypotheses": [
    {"name": "Hypothesis 1", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high R&D spending (RD) and high idiosyncratic risk (IdioVol3F) may be undervalued due to investor fear of uncertainty, resulting in a higher return when these fears are proven to be unfounded.", 
     "expression": {
         "terms": [{"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], 
         "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", 
         "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
         {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, 
         {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, 
         {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "RD", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
    {"name": "Hypothesis 2", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high advertising expense (AdExp) and high international exposure (sinAlgo) may experience higher returns due to expanding markets, consumer recognition, and strong international presence.", 
     "expression": {
         "terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AdExp"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "sinAlgo"}], 
         "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", 
         "vol_target": false}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
         {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, 
         {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, 
         {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": null},
    {"name": "Hypothesis 3", 
     "mechanism": "Companies with high equity issuance (CompEquIss) and low earnings-per-share (FEPS) signal potential overvaluation, leading to lower future returns.", 
     "expression": {
         "terms": [{"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "CompEquIss"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "FEPS"}], 
         "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", 
         "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
         {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, 
         {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, 
         {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "FEPS", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.55, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 45},
    {"name": "Hypothesis 4", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high organizational capital (OrgCap) and low volatility (RealizedVol) may benefit from having well-structured operations and low risk, leading to higher future returns.", 
     "expression": {
         "terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OrgCap"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "RealizedVol"}], 
         "regime": null, 
         "vol_target": false}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
         {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, 
         {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "OrgCap", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}, 
         {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": null},
    {"name": "Hypothesis 5", 
     "mechanism": "Companies with high cash flow to market (CF) and high bid-ask spread (BidAskSpread) may signal undervaluation and illiquidity, leading to higher future returns.", 
     "expression": {
         "terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "CF"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "BidAskSpread"}], 
         "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", 
         "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
         {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, 
         {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, 
         {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "CF", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 48},
    {"name": "Hypothesis 6", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high asset growth (AssetGrowth) and high governance index (Governance) may signal good governance and investment opportunities, leading to higher future returns.", 
     "expression": {
         "terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "Governance"}], 
         "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", 
         "vol_target": false}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
         {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, 
         {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, 
         {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "AssetGrowth", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.68, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 60},
    {"name": "Hypothesis 7", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high order backlog (OrderBacklog) and low idiosyncratic skewness (ReturnSkew3F) may signal high future demand and low risk, leading to higher future returns.", 
     "expression": {
         "terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OrderBacklog"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "ReturnSkew3F"}], 
         "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", 
         "vol_target": true}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
         {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "stronger"}, 
         {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "same_sign"}, 
         {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "OrderBacklog", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
    {"name": "Hypothesis 8", 
     "mechanism": "Firms with high earnings consistency (EarningsConsistency) and low distress (Oscore) may be seen as stable and less risky, leading to higher future returns.", 
     "expression": {
         "terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Oscore"}], 
         "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", 
         "vol_target": false}, 
     "auxiliary_predictions": [
         {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "stronger"}, 
         {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, 
         {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
     "expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65, 
     "expected_decay_half_life_months": 50}
]}
